description: Arrival at a node whose World-Turn drift entry the digest carries — DM folds the drift into the arrival beat rather than dumping the raw ledger line.

arrivalBrief.text: the eel-weirs stand empty three days running

response.narration: The stilts creak under you as you climb up onto the boardwalk. It's quieter than a fishing village has any right to be — the eel-weirs along the pilings hang slack and empty, and nobody's tending them. Whatever usually keeps this place humming has stopped.
response.dmNotes: drift folded into sensory arrival, not stated as a fact-dump
